caption: The drawing consists of a single central object depicted in black and white pencil or ink on a plain beige paper background. The object appears to be a vessel or container with a symmetrical, vertical, urn-like form. It has a rounded base that flares outward, a narrower midsection, and a domed, perforated lid with a small knop or finial on top. The lid shows detailed decorative patterns with scroll-like perforations. Below the central illustration, there is a scaled-down side view of the same object enclosed in a smaller rectangular frame with measurement indicators and the label “SCALE 1:1 IN.” The artist’s signature, "MEYERS," is present near the main illustration on the left. The drawing uses shading to give the object a three-dimensional appearance, with no additional colors or background elements included.
title: Salt Shaker
